title: cymbidium dayanum subsp. leachianum
intro: Cymbidium dayanum subsp. leachianum, commonly known as the Leach's Cymbidium, is a species of orchid native to the Himalayas. It is an evergreen perennial plant known for its delicate white flowers and slender green leaves. The Leach's Cymbidium is said to possess various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function, likely due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids have been identified in the plant, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
